verdict: Organic channels holding; paid campaigns remain off across all locations.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, your businesses generated 382 combined Google Business Profile actions this period entirely through unpaid sources — paid advertising has been inactive across all three locations for the full 28 days, meaning no trackable leads were captured. Advance Grinding's GBP activity rose 30% week-over-week, a positive signal, while O'Hare Precision's GBP engagement dropped 37% and Forte Metals' fell 71%, showing that organic momentum alone is uneven and cannot be relied on to sustain lead flow. Website tracking at O'Hare Precision is also being repaired, so web session data under-reports actual visitor activity this period. Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate priority to put a reliable lead engine back in place across all locations.
